text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, while out with Yukino Bijin, I
casually
take my phone out to check
whether I have any
work-related
messages...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Is everyth'n okay? D'you have things you
need
t'do today?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Checking work stuff? Y'know, Trainer... Today's a day off for your body and your mind.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I've got an idea! How 'bout I hold
onto your
phone for the day? It'll be like
one of those
digi-detoxes!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A digi-detox, or digital detox, is when
someone
willingly refrains from using
technology for a short
while.
Apparently, it helps to reduce stress...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Thanks! Now we just need t'keep things
nice 'n'
laidback for the rest of the day.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
But what'd be a relax'n thing to do...
Hmmm...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Oh, I think I know just the place.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Before I know it, I've been brought
along to the
planetarium.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... ♪ T'tell you the truth, I heard
that they're
doing a show based on a
nurs'ry rhyme from
Morioka, and I just
couldn't miss it.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I sang the song all the time when I was
li'l.
Ohhh, the reeed-eyed
scorpiooon... ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yukino Bijin quietly sings the lyrics in
the
pamphlet to me... The melody is
clear and catchy.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
This really brings back mem'ries. I used
to climb
onto the roof of our house and
sing that song
while look'n for the stars
in the song...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it's about t'start... Hehe... Let's take
a tour of the
stars for a little while...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The stars from the song twinkle in time
with the
soft music... There's Scorpio,
Aquila, Canis
Minor...

Orion sings from on high... ♪ As dew and
frost
trickle down... ♪

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Round and round the sky... ♪

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
...The stars are so beautiful. C'mon, let's
go even
further... There's all kinds of
sights wait'n for us!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She wants to go even further. The
world's such a
huge place, and she's
dreaming so big... The road
to that
dream stretches out far in front of us.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As I look up at the vast and starry sky, I
start to
wonder... just how impossibly
small was the
probability of us both
being born on the same
planet in the
same era...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even with the world being so huge, the
two of us
found each other by total
chance—and now,
together, we're
chasing the same dream.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Golly, that sure was beautiful. The stars
just go on
and on forever...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
And even with the universe being this
huge, we
still found each other...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: It's a real miracle we even met...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: It's a real miracle we even met...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Do what? Is what I said that surpris'n?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I mean, the chances of us meet'n at all
were so
astronomically small!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Hey! Are you laugh'n at me?! Did I say
someth'n
weird?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I guess m-maybe "miracle" was kinda
dramatic... I
didn't mean for things t'get
weird.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: But... that's honestly what I was think'n...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. T'day was a whooole lotta fun.
And what a
coinkydink that we were
both think'n the same
thing!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yukino Bijin smiles as she walks beside
me. We
share our impressions of the
show as we leisurely
stroll back home.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Ah, your phone! Guess I should give it
back to
you, huh?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... Then maybe I should keep't a
little longer.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: There's still so, so much I wanna talk about!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
You were?! R-really?! Hot dog, what a

coinkydink!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
That's so funny... I didn't even say
anyth'n!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
It's like we're connected somehow—even
without
our phones!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... I'm pretty sure our hearts're
connected!
We've come a long way
t'gether, after all!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Would you like t'watch another show
before we
head back?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I wanna spend a little more time look'n
up at the
stars and forgett'n about the
daily grind...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Before long, the starry sky is sprawling
out over
our heads once more.
Forgetting our hectic
everyday lives, we
enjoy the tranquility together.
